about_the_game:
Step into the arena of legends.
Fablery is a tactical card game where heroes from myths and legends clash on a board that feels like a living fresco. Hades versus Alice, Dracula against Sherlock Holmes… every battle opens the door to unexpected encounters that instantly surprise and captivate.

Strategic yet accessible gameplay.
Each hero comes with a unique deck that reflects their personality and powers. No tedious deckbuilding: jump straight into the action. Deploy your units, anticipate your opponent’s moves, and turn the tide of battle through clever tactical decisions.

Modes for every player.

  • Intense 1v1 duels

  • Story-driven solo missions

  • Cooperative 2v2 battles

A distinctive artistic direction.
Inspired by gouache painting, Fablery’s visual identity brings to life a wide range of worlds, from luminous beauty to unsettling darkness. Each match becomes a stage where strategy and imagination intertwine.

Whether you’re a fan of card games, tactical challenges, or timeless myths, Fablery delivers a unique experience: accessible, deep, and full of memorable duels.

Minimum:

  • OS *: Windows 7
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-760 (4 * 2800); AMD Athlon II X4 645 AM3 (4 * 3100)
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 550 Ti (3072 VRAM); Radeon HD 6850 (1024 VRAM)
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-3470 (4 * 3200); AMD FX-4350 (4 * 4200)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1050 2048 VRAM; Radeon RX 460 4096 VRAM
